title: A shaped degree-eight source has a two-step degree-eight composition chain
statement: There exist a shaped irreducible binary polynomial f of degree 8 and nonmonomial shaped binary polynomials sigma_1 and sigma_2 of degree 8 such that f(sigma_1) and f(sigma_1)(sigma_2) are irreducible.

formal.statement: {"exists":"shaped irreducible f degree 8 and shaped nonmonomial sigma_1,sigma_2 degree 8 with f(sigma_1),f(sigma_1)(sigma_2) irreducible","field_order":2,"format":"axeyum-gf2-degree-eight-octuple-two-step-chain","version":1}

evidence.supports: Complete enumeration of the two shaped irreducible degree-eight sources and all 31 nonmonomial shaped degree-eight substitutions at both stages; four certified first-stage outputs and zero certified continuations.
evidence.notes: This refutes only the stated repeated degree-eight chain. It does not refute isolated degree-64-to-512 compositions or chains using a different substitution degree.

provenance.source: bounded exhaustive native search with replayed Rabin certificates

notes: The review sweep's positive degree-64 and degree-512 examples used unrelated source selections and therefore did not establish the existential chain refuted here.
